title: SCP Scorecard Central Index
description: Central aggregator output produced by the weekly `scorecard-aggregator.yml` workflow run. Aggregates verified `scorecard-emit.json` artifacts from opted-in adopters into a single signed-via-git-history index. NEVER carries waiver content (`reason`, `approved_by`, `waiver_id` strings) — invariant 2 of WP-SCP-023 plan-doc binds this. Per-adopter rows preserve the verified emit's aggregated counts AND a verification status; failure modes are recorded loudly (status: verification_failure / unreachable / no_emit), never silently dropped. Index trust is rooted in git's required-signed-commits (020J) + `output/scorecards/** @jrnb2024` CODEOWNERS coverage + branch protection on main, NOT a separate Ed25519 signature layer (the WP-SCP-021 MCP signing key infrastructure is for runtime MCP receipts; the aggregator's index commits to git directly via the workflow's `contents: write` job-scoped permission, gated by CODEOWNERS review on every aggregator-produced PR).

schema_version.description: Index schema version. Consumers (markdown report generator at 023D, MCP method at 023D) drop indexes with unknown schema_version.

aggregated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the aggregator run produced this index.

aggregator_run_id.description: GitHub Actions workflow run ID for the aggregator run that produced this index. Permits operators to trace back to the run logs.

adopters.description: Per-adopter rows. Order canonical (sorted by `repo`). MUST include every entry from the opt-in-registry — adopters that fail verification are recorded with `status: verification_failure` (or unreachable / no_emit), not dropped.

status.description: verified = emit fetched + OIDC verified + schema-valid. verification_failure = emit fetched but `gh attestation verify --signer-workflow` failed OR schema validation failed. unreachable = `gh run download` failed (deleted repo / rate limit / network). no_emit = no green policy-check run found within last 7 days OR run had no scorecard-emit artifact (adopter opted into registry but their wrapper's `scorecard-emit: true` input is not set).

last_emit_run_id.description: GitHub Actions run ID of the adopter's policy-check run the emit was downloaded from. Present iff status in (verified, verification_failure).

last_emit_commit.description: Commit SHA the emit was produced for. Present iff status in (verified, verification_failure).

last_emit_emitted_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp from the emit's `emitted_at` field. Present iff status == verified.

verdict.description: Pass-through from the verified emit. Present iff status == verified.

rule_counts.description: Pass-through from the verified emit. Present iff status == verified. Per-rule aggregated counts. NEVER carries waiver content — schema enforces `additionalProperties: false` at every level.

waivers_aggregate.description: Pass-through from the verified emit. Present iff status == verified. NEVER waiver content.

rule_config_aggregate.description: Pass-through from the verified emit. Present iff status == verified.

scp_version.description: Pass-through from the verified emit. Present iff status == verified.

ref.description: Pass-through from the verified emit. Present iff status == verified.

error.description: Failure-mode error string. Present iff status in (verification_failure, unreachable, no_emit). Bounded to 2000 chars to avoid log spam in the index.
